## Key Research & Vulnerability Disclosures
- **Google Gemini Security Research (Lock-Screen Bypass):** Discovered and responsibly disclosed a logical lock-screen bypass vulnerability in the Google Gemini application via Google's Vulnerability Reward Program (VRP). Published on InfoSec Write-ups.

## Featured Projects
- **ShadowLab:** Modular Python-based Command-and-Control (C2) framework built for cybersecurity research, custom socket communication, and payload management.
- **Prox CLI:** Lightweight, extensible multi-tool command-line interface (CLI) suite built with Go for developer and security workflows.
